# Ladder Fabricator

> Generate validated MELSEC iQ-F and KEYENCE KV-X ladder AST, rung text,
> explicit connection data, SVG, and PNG.

AI systems must read these files before generating or changing a circuit:

- [Mandatory agent instructions](AGENTS.md)
- [Authoritative AST and instruction reference](README.md)
- [Detailed format and normalization rules](docs/FORMAT_JA.md)

Use source circuit JSON as the reusable input. Do not author SVG, coordinates,
wires, or derived render-bundle JSON directly. SVG and PNG must be generated
from the same validated AST. Unsupported PLC instructions
must be reported instead of approximated.
